stories.title: One guest wears yellow to Miley Cyrus's all-black wedding
stories.summary: A photo from the ceremony showed rows of guests in black and one woman in bright yellow, and the internet spent the day arguing about wedding dress codes.

stories.title: A New York assemblyman's 'lizard eyes' behind Mamdani
stories.summary: A clip of Jordan Wright blinking behind Zohran Mamdani at a press conference sent conspiracy accounts into reptilian theories.
